description: This file is a shell script used for testing various forms of corruption handling in Git repositories. It contains functions to manipulate Git object files directly and a series of test cases to verify Git's behavior when encountering corrupted or missing objects.

methods.name: obj_to_file
methods.description: Converts a Git object reference into a file path within the object storage directory.

methods.name: corrupt_byte
methods.description: Corrupts a specific byte at a given offset within a Git object file.
